name: copperline-debug
description: Debug Amiga programs in the Copperline emulator: source-level stepping, registers, memory, chipset state and reverse execution through copperline-ctl --dap.

copperline.ctlExecutable.description: Path to the copperline-ctl executable file (not its directory); it serves the debug adapter as copperline-ctl --dap. A bare name is looked up on PATH.

copperline.emulatorExecutable.description: Path to the copperline executable file (not its directory) that a launch starts. Empty: the copperline next to copperline-ctl, else PATH. A launch configuration's "copperline" attribute overrides this.

program.description: The Amiga executable (hunk file) to run, on the host. Its directory is mounted in the guest and it is started from the shell.

copperline.description: The copperline executable file to start (default: the copperline.emulatorExecutable setting, then the copperline next to copperline-ctl, then PATH).

config.description: A Copperline TOML configuration file for the machine (default: the launcher's saved default configuration).

model.description: Machine model (A500, A600, A1200, A4000, CD32...).

rtcTime.description: Seed the guest clock (copperline --rtc-time), for reproducible runs.

headless.description: Run without a window (copperline --control instead of --control-gui). The screen is then only reachable through the control protocol.

stopOnEntry.description: Stop at the program's entry point once it is loaded.

entryPoint.description: The symbol to treat as the entry point (default: the first instruction of the first hunk). "main" or "entry" for C programs with a startup stub.

symbolFile.description: An ELF with DWARF the program was converted from (elf2hunk); "program.elf" is tried automatically.

sourceMap.description: Source path prefixes recorded in the debug information mapped to host paths, {"/build/dir": "${workspaceFolder}"}.

cwd.description: Working directory for the emulator process.

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the emulator to announce its control endpoint.

controlInfo.description: The JSON file a running copperline wrote with --control-info.

address.description: The control server address (with token) when no info file is at hand.

program.description: The executable the guest is running or about to run, for its symbols and source lines.

symbolFile.description: An ELF with DWARF the program was converted from.

stopOnEntry.description: When the program is not loaded yet, stop at its entry point once it is.
